results.description: Taepung Shin knows every nook and cranny of his favorite MMO video game Paradiso like it was the back of his hand! However, his gaming adventures suffer an abrupt end after his untimely death. But this is not his last hurrah since he’s reincarnated as Jared, a delinquent lord of a frozen province… in Paradiso! Now, he must brave the world he loved and take advantage of all glitches he knows about and turn himself into the main character of his new solo adventure!

results.description:
After fighting with her parents, Tina decided to run away from home for a short weekend trip and fully enjoy her hobby. Her hobby is "solo dungeons". Even though it's a dungeon, it's not like she's defeating vicious bosses or aiming for get-rich-quick treasures like a hero or professional adventurer. She dives into beginner-friendly dungeons alone to enjoy hunting, cooking, and camping. Nevertheless, a dungeon is a dungeon, and unpredictable accidents also occur...!?

The highly anticipated 1st volume of the popular work that overwhelmingly ranked No. 1 in page views for AlphaPolis original manga in 2024!

(Source: Translated from EbookJapan)
